meaning.en: Jumping about energetically; lively and full of health.
meaning.zh: 形容欢蹦乱跳、充满活力的样子。

examples.zh: 孩子退烧后，第二天又活蹦乱跳了。
examples.en: Once the fever broke, the child was bouncing around again the next day.

examples.zh: 市场上的鱼虾都是活蹦乱跳的。
examples.en: The fish and prawns at the market are all alive and kicking.

examples.zh: 小狗一见主人回家就活蹦乱跳。
examples.en: The puppy leaps about as soon as its owner comes home.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often 活蹦乱跳的. Used of children, animals and fresh seafood.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常说“活蹦乱跳的”，多用于孩子、小动物或鲜活的鱼虾。

natural: send a chill down the spine

meaning.en: To shudder with fear although it is not cold.
meaning.zh: 不冷却发抖，形容非常恐惧。

equivalents: send a chill down one's spine

examples.zh: 一想起那场车祸，我就不寒而栗。
examples.en: Just thinking about that car crash sends a chill down my spine.

examples.zh: 报道中的细节令人不寒而栗。
examples.en: The details in the report are chilling.

examples.zh: 他冷冷的目光让人不寒而栗。
examples.en: His icy stare made people's blood run cold.

story.en: The harsh official Yi Zong had over four hundred people executed in one day; afterwards the whole commandery 'shivered though it was not cold'.
story.zh: 《史记》载酷吏义纵一日报杀四百余人，“其后郡中不寒而栗”。

usage.en: Predicate; often 令人不寒而栗.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“令人不寒而栗”。

meaning.en: Concise in wording yet complete in meaning.
meaning.zh: 话语简练，意思完备。

examples.zh: 他的发言言简意赅，大家一听就明白。
examples.en: His speech was short and to the point; everyone understood at once.

examples.zh: 写摘要要言简意赅。
examples.en: An abstract should be concise.

examples.zh: 这封邮件言简意赅，没有一句废话。
examples.en: The email is succinct, without a wasted word.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for speech and writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，用于说话或文章。

meaning.en: To deliberately avoid talking about something.
meaning.zh: 故意回避，不谈论。

examples.zh: 记者问到裁员，经理避而不谈。
examples.en: When reporters asked about layoffs, the manager sidestepped the question.

examples.zh: 对于分手的原因，她一直避而不谈。
examples.en: She has always avoided talking about why they broke up.

examples.zh: 报告对关键数据避而不谈。
examples.en: The report steers clear of the key figures.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“对……避而不谈”。

meaning.en: Clear and logical point by point; well reasoned (sometimes ironic of mere talk).
meaning.zh: 说话做事很有条理，每一点都有道理。

examples.zh: 他分析起股市来头头是道。
examples.en: When he analyses the stock market, it all makes perfect sense.

examples.zh: 这孩子讲道理讲得头头是道。
examples.en: The child argues the case very logically.

examples.zh: 说得头头是道，做起来却一塌糊涂。
examples.en: He talks a good game, but his actual work is a mess.

usage.en: Usually complement after 说得/讲得; can be ironic.
usage.zh: 多作补语，常说“说得头头是道”，有时含讽刺意味。

meaning.en: To pitch camp; (fig.) to settle in somewhere for a while.
meaning.zh: 军队设置营寨驻扎下来，也泛指临时住下或设立据点。

examples.zh: 天黑前，登山队在山脚下安营扎寨。
examples.en: Before dark, the climbers pitched camp at the foot of the mountain.

examples.zh: 不少科技公司在这个园区安营扎寨。
examples.en: Many tech firms have set up shop in this park.

examples.zh: 军队在河边安营扎寨。
examples.en: The army made camp by the river.

meaning.en: Above criticism; perfectly justified.
meaning.zh: 没有什么可以指责的，表示言行合乎情理。

examples.zh: 维护自身权益是无可非议的。
examples.en: Standing up for your own rights is perfectly justified.

examples.zh: 他的处理方式无可非议。
examples.en: The way he handled it was beyond reproach.

usage.en: Predicate; often 是无可非议的.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“是无可非议的”。

meaning.en: Able to do anything; all-powerful.
meaning.zh: 没有什么不会做的，形容本领极大。

examples.zh: 在孩子眼里，爸爸是无所不能的。
examples.en: In a child's eyes, Dad can do anything.

examples.zh: 别以为有了钱就无所不能。
examples.en: Don't think money makes you all-powerful.

examples.zh: 人工智能并非无所不能。
examples.en: Artificial intelligence is not omnipotent.

meaning.en: Completely exhausted.
meaning.zh: 形容非常疲劳，一点力气也没有了。

examples.zh: 跑完马拉松，他已经筋疲力尽。
examples.en: After the marathon he was completely worn out.

examples.zh: 连续加班一周，大家都筋疲力尽了。
examples.en: After a week of overtime, everyone was exhausted.

examples.zh: 带了一天孩子，她累得筋疲力尽。
examples.en: After a day looking after the kids, she was dead on her feet.

usage.en: Predicate or complement after 累得.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也常作补语，如“累得筋疲力尽”。

meaning.en: Through repeated contact over time; gradually.
meaning.zh: 经过反复接触或交往，逐渐地。

examples.zh: 两人在同一个部门，一来二去就熟了。
examples.en: They were in the same department, and over time they got to know each other.

examples.zh: 一来二去，他们成了好朋友。
examples.en: One thing led to another, and they became good friends.

usage.en: Usually at the start of a clause.
usage.zh: 多用在分句开头，作状语。

meaning.en: To rush in all at once in a disorderly crowd, often blindly following others.
meaning.zh: 形容许多人不加考虑地一下子都涌上去，也比喻盲目跟风。

examples.zh: 一看到打折，顾客们一哄而上。
examples.en: As soon as they saw the discount, shoppers piled in.

examples.zh: 新能源项目不能一哄而上。
examples.en: We mustn't all jump on the clean-energy bandwagon without thinking.

examples.zh: 球一落地，孩子们一哄而上抢了起来。
examples.en: As soon as the ball landed, the children rushed at it.

usage.en: Predicate; in policy language warns against herd behaviour.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，政策语言中常用来批评盲目跟风。

meaning.en: Without allowing any explanation or argument.
meaning.zh: 不容许分辩解释。

examples.zh: 妈妈不由分说，把我拉回了家。
examples.en: Without letting me say a word, Mum dragged me home.

examples.zh: 保安不由分说地把他赶了出去。
examples.en: The guard threw him out without further ado.

usage.en: Adverbial, at the start of a clause.

meaning.en: Difficult to predict.
meaning.zh: 很难事先估计到。

examples.zh: 比赛结果难以预料。
examples.en: The result of the match is hard to predict.

examples.zh: 疫情的发展难以预料。
examples.en: How the epidemic will develop is anyone's guess.

examples.zh: 投资有风险，收益难以预料。
examples.en: Investment carries risk, and returns are unpredictable.

meaning.en: Thoroughly satisfying and uninhibited (of writing, performance, a game or a feeling).
meaning.zh: 形容非常畅快，尽情尽兴，多指文章、表演或比赛。

examples.zh: 这场比赛打得酣畅淋漓。
examples.en: It was an exhilarating game.

examples.zh: 他的文章写得酣畅淋漓。
examples.en: His essay is written with great verve and freedom.

examples.zh: 出了一身汗，感觉酣畅淋漓。
examples.en: After a good sweat I felt thoroughly refreshed.

meaning.en: Bustling and hurried; brisk and energetic.
meaning.zh: 形容急急忙忙或干劲十足的样子。

examples.zh: 她风风火火地跑进办公室。
examples.en: She came rushing into the office in a tearing hurry.

examples.zh: 他做事一向风风火火。
examples.en: He always does things briskly and energetically.

examples.zh: 项目风风火火地启动了。
examples.en: The project got off to a whirlwind start.

meaning.en: To pass oneself off as someone else and take their place.
meaning.zh: 假冒别人的名义，代替他去做事或享受权利。

examples.zh: 他冒名顶替别人上了大学。
examples.en: He got into university by impersonating someone else.

examples.zh: 考场严查冒名顶替的考生。
examples.en: The exam hall checks rigorously for candidates sitting the test in someone else's name.

examples.zh: 这起冒名顶替案引起社会关注。
examples.en: This impersonation case has attracted public attention.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often in news.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，新闻中常用。

meaning.en: To protect one's home and defend one's country.
meaning.zh: 保卫家乡，捍卫祖国。

examples.zh: 战士们为了保家卫国献出了生命。
examples.en: The soldiers gave their lives to defend their country.

examples.zh: 他从小就立志参军，保家卫国。
examples.en: Since childhood he had wanted to join the army and defend his country.

usage.en: Predicate or object; formal and patriotic.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，庄重语体。

meaning.en: In the prime of life, with plenty of years ahead and full vigour.
meaning.zh: 年纪轻，精力旺盛。

examples.zh: 新任经理年富力强，经验丰富。
examples.en: The new manager is in his prime and highly experienced.

examples.zh: 要大胆提拔年富力强的干部。
examples.en: We should boldly promote officials in the prime of life.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often of officials and staff.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多用于干部、人才。

meaning.en: Wealth obtained by improper or dishonest means.
meaning.zh: 用不正当手段得来的钱财。

examples.zh: 不义之财终究守不住。
examples.en: Ill-gotten gains never last.

examples.zh: 他拒绝收下这笔不义之财。
examples.en: He refused to take the dirty money.

meaning.en: Things happen for a reason; there is a cause behind it.
meaning.zh: 事情的发生是有原因的。

examples.zh: 他这次发火事出有因。
examples.en: There was a reason for his outburst this time.

examples.zh: 事出有因，我们先别急着批评他。
examples.en: There must be a reason, so let's not rush to criticise him.

meaning.en: To see someone in mortal danger and not help.
meaning.zh: 看到别人有生命危险却不去救助。

examples.zh: 我们不能见死不救。
examples.en: We can't just stand by and let him die.

examples.zh: 有人指责路人见死不救。
examples.en: Some accused the passers-by of leaving the victim to die.

meaning.en: Ambiguous and noncommittal, taking neither side clearly.
meaning.zh: 对事情的正反两方面含含糊糊，不表示明确态度。

examples.zh: 他的回答模棱两可，让人摸不着头脑。
examples.en: His answer was so ambiguous that no one could make sense of it.

examples.zh: 合同条款不能模棱两可。
examples.en: Contract terms mustn't be ambiguous.

examples.zh: 在原则问题上不能模棱两可。
examples.en: You can't sit on the fence on matters of principle.

story.en: Tang chief minister Su Weidao advised: 'Don't decide things clearly; just hold on to both edges (模棱以持两端).' He was nicknamed 'Su Moleng'.
story.zh: 唐代宰相苏味道说：处事不欲决断明白，“但模棱以持两端可矣”，时人称他“苏模棱”。

meaning.en: To embezzle money that passes through one's hands.
meaning.zh: 经手钱财时从中贪污，装满自己的腰包。

examples.zh: 他利用职务之便中饱私囊。
examples.en: He used his position to line his own pockets.

examples.zh: 扶贫资金绝不能被中饱私囊。
examples.en: Poverty-relief funds must never be embezzled.

meaning.en: Very frequently; almost every day.
meaning.zh: 形容次数频繁，隔不了几天就……

examples.zh: 他三天两头请假。
examples.en: He takes time off every other day.

examples.zh: 这台电脑三天两头出问题。
examples.en: This computer goes wrong all the time.

examples.zh: 她三天两头往娘家跑。
examples.en: She's always popping round to her parents'.

meaning.en: So poor as if washed clean of everything.
meaning.zh: 穷得像被水冲洗过一样，什么都没有。

equivalents: without a penny to one's name

examples.zh: 创业失败后，他一贫如洗。
examples.en: After his business failed, he was left penniless.

examples.zh: 当年他家一贫如洗，连学费都交不起。
examples.en: His family was so poor back then that they couldn't even pay the school fees.
